```sql
-- name: top_products
-- owner: merchandising
-- params: tenant_id, from, to, limit
-- Best sellers by units and revenue. Line items reference the variant by its
-- string id (integration feed), so it is cast when joining the catalog.
WITH fo AS (
  SELECT o.id
    FROM orders o
   WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
     AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
     AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
     AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
line_agg AS (
  SELECT ol.variant_id::uuid        AS variant_id,
         ol.order_id,
         sum(ol.quantity)           AS qty,
         sum(ol.line_total_cents)   AS rev
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN fo ON fo.id = ol.order_id
   GROUP BY ol.variant_id::uuid, ol.order_id
),
product_order AS (
  SELECT pv.product_id,
         la.order_id,
         sum(la.qty) AS qty,
         sum(la.rev) AS rev
    FROM line_agg la
    JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = la.variant_id
   GROUP BY pv.product_id, la.order_id
),
product_agg AS (
  SELECT po.product_id,
         count(*)              AS order_count,
         sum(po.qty)::bigint   AS quantity,
         sum(po.rev)           AS revenue_cents
    FROM product_order po
   GROUP BY po.product_id
),
variant_cnt AS (
  SELECT pv.product_id,
         count(*) AS variant_count
    FROM product_variants pv
   WHERE pv.id IN (SELECT la.variant_id FROM line_agg la)
   GROUP BY pv.product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       pa.order_count,
       pa.quantity,
       pa.revenue_cents,
       vc.variant_count
  FROM product_agg pa
  JOIN variant_cnt vc ON vc.product_id = pa.product_id
  JOIN products p     ON p.id = pa.product_id
 ORDER BY pa.quantity DESC, pa.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De herschrijving aggregeert eerst smal per variant en order, zodat de dure `count(DISTINCT)`-sorts op brede rijen met productkolommen verdwijnen. De `products`-join gebeurt pas op het kleine aggregaat. Bij gelijke `quantity` en `revenue_cents` is de volgorde niet gedefinieerd, net als in het origineel, dus die is niet gegarandeerd gelijk.
